trigger_phrase_or_event: creator approved copy direction and asked for visually captivating zoom-out/zoom-in psychology

copy_lock.copy: Not every love story needs a big life.
She points at the sky. He looks at her first.

visual_system_candidates.name: Zoom-Out To Attention Pivot
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Uses scale, gaze psychology, and closeness progression to make the emotion readable without heavy copy.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Slide 1 can become too landscape-first if the couple is emotionally unreadable.

visual_system_candidates.name: Same-Frame Sky Romance
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Directly resembles the supplied inspiration image.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Too close to the external reference and likely to become a pretty quote-card scene.

visual_system_candidates.name: Close-Up From The Start
visual_system_candidates.risk: Loses the creator-requested zoom-out/zoom-in movement and the psychological reveal.

why_it_wins: It gives the viewer a controlled emotional journey: awe opens attention, his gaze redirects the story, and touch/proximity closes the loop as home.
rejected_visual_patterns: both partners only staring at the sky
psychology_notes: Slide 1 uses scale and negative space to create awe and curiosity.
Slide 2 uses gaze-cue violation: viewers expect the sky to matter, but his eyes make her the focal reward.
Slide 3 uses proximity, hands, and shared movement to create attachment closure.

typography_and_aspect_plan.instagram_post_4x5: Keep text in warm upper-middle negative space with the couple lower/middle-lower. Slide 2 text must not cover her pointing hand or his eye-line.
typography_and_aspect_plan.reels_stories_9x16: Generate separate native tall compositions with more vertical sky on slide 1, more headroom around the pointing gesture on slide 2, and more warm breathing room above the close-up on slide 3.
typography_and_aspect_plan.brandmark: Tiny low-contrast handwritten @a.storyof.two at bottom-right inside artwork.

downstream_requirements: visual-debate.json must preserve the selected zoom-out to zoom-in system.
visual-plan-quality.json must block any slide where the relationship emotion is not readable without text.
prompt-pack.json must use the creator-locked master prompt and the Observational Intimacy Premium style lock.
